d: Iran’s security chief Mohsen Rezaei has attributed remarks about a growing Hindu-Jewish alliance against Muslims and Pakistan to Pakistan Army chief Asim Munir during a four-country security meeting in Tehran on October 26. The claims come amid expanding India-Israel cooperation in defence, intelligence and technology. Meanwhile, gold prices have rallied following the US midterm elections, as oil prices and the US dollar weakened after Democrats took control of Congress. Firstpost examines why investors are turning to gold, silver and platinum, and how the surge could affect Indian buyers…
